changelog: **Admin routes behind the permission layer — integrations & settings (#1571, story #1565):** `/api/admin/integrations/**` (chat, Google status, health, JaaS usage, Klaviyo), `webhooks/**` (incl. `rotate-secret`, `test`, deliveries and replays), `audit-drains/**` (incl. `rotate-secret`, `test`), `api-keys` and `roster-feeds/**` authorize through `requirePermission()` (`org.integrations.read` for reads, `org.integrations.write` for every write, secret rotation, test send, sync and replay); `settings` (GET/PUT) and `settings/history`, `ai/status`, `ai/usage`, `ai/policy`, `migrate` and `marketing-accounts` use `org.settings.read` / `org.settings.write`, and the budget-spending `ai/draft`, `ai/translate` and `ai/company-enrich` need `org.settings.write` — instead of comparing the role to `'ADMIN'`. The private `requireAdmin()` helpers of `api-keys`, `webhooks`, `audit-drains` and `roster-feeds` are gone; the super-admin checks on deployment-global settings are unchanged. Behaviour-neutral for existing admins; a signed-in non-admin now gets 403 instead of 401.
